title: Beaks & Feet Worksheets | 1st Science Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: 1-LS1-1

Give your learners extra practice with Beaks & Feet! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • What Is the Beak For?
  • What Are the Feet For?
  • Seed Eater or Meat Eater?
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (What Is the Beak For?, What Are the Feet For?, Seed Eater or Meat Eater?), so children can play, then print and practice
